question: Bal ka SI unit kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bal ka SI unit Newton (N) hai; F = m × a se unit kg·m/s² banta hai. | Galat kyun: Pascal dabav ka, Joule karya/urja ka, Watt shakti ka unit hai. | Concept: Har bhautik rashi ka apna SI unit hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: F=ma → Newton; W=Fs → Joule; P=W/t → Watt. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Force and Laws of Motion).

question: Ohm's Law kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Ohm's Law: V = IR (Voltage = Current × Resistance). | Galat kyun: V = I/R ulta hai; F = ma Newton ka dusra niyam hai; P = VI shakti ka sutra hai (sahi sutra, galat sawal). | Concept: Sthir tapman par V ∝ I hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: VIR — V = I × R. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 11 (Electricity).

question: Prakash ki gati vacuum me kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Prakash ki gati vacuum me 3 × 10^8 m/s hai — brahmand ki sabse tez gati. | Galat kyun: 10^5 aur 10^6 ghataank galat hain; 10^10 bahut zyada hai. | Concept: Prakash ko chalne ke liye madhyam nahi chahiye. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3-8 — 3 × 10^8. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 9 (Light).

question: Myopia (nikat drishti) ko kis lens se sudhara jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Myopia (nikat drishti) me door ki vastu dhundhli dikhti hai kyunki image retina se pehle banti hai; avtal (concave) lens prakash ko failakar image ko retina par lata hai. | Galat kyun: Uttal (convex) lens Hypermetropia ke liye hai; cylindrical lens astigmatism ke liye; bifocal dono dosh ke liye. | Concept: Lens prakash ko modkar image ki jagah badalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Myopia = Minus (concave) lens. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 10 (Human Eye).

question: Akash neela kyun dikhai deta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Akash neela prakash ke prakirnan (scattering) ke karan dikhta hai: neele rang ki tarangdairdhya sabse chhoti hoti hai, isliye vah sabse zyada bikharta hai. | Galat kyun: Vivartan (diffraction), prativartan (reflection) aur apvartan (refraction) alag ghatnayen hain. | Concept: Rayleigh scattering — bikhrao ∝ 1/λ⁴. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Neela sabse chhota, sabse zyada bikharta. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 10.

question: Dhvani ki gati hawa me lagbhag kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Dhvani ki gati hawa me ~343 m/s (20°C par) hai; vacuum me dhvani bilkul nahi chalti kyunki use madhyam chahiye. | Galat kyun: 1,500 m/s pani me dhvani ki gati ke aas-paas hai; 3 × 10^8 m/s prakash ki gati hai; 150 m/s galat hai. | Concept: Dhvani ki gati madhyam par nirbhar karti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Hawa 343, pani ~1500, prakash 3×10^8. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Sound).

question: Bharat me ghar ki bijli ka voltage aur frequency kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat me ghar ki bijli 220 V, 50 Hz AC hai. | Galat kyun: 110 V / 60 Hz America ka manak hai; 220 V / 60 Hz aur 110 V / 50 Hz kisi bade desh ka ghar-manak nahi. | Concept: Har desh ka voltage-frequency manak alag hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bharat 220-50; America 110-60. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 12; standard GK.

question: 1 HP kitne watt ke barabar hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 1 Horsepower = 746 Watt (James Watt ki paribhasha). | Galat kyun: 1,000 W = 1 kW hai; 550 ft-lb/s purani imperial paribhasha hai, watt nahi; 500 W galat hai. | Concept: Shakti = karya / samay. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 746 — HP ka number. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Work and Energy).

question: Archimedes ka siddhant kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Archimedes ka siddhant utplavan (buoyancy) se hai: utplavan bal = visthapit drav ka bhar. | Galat kyun: Prakash, gati aur dabav se iska seedha sambandh nahi. | Concept: Dubi vastu par drav upar ki or bal lagata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Archimedes — nahate samay 'Eureka'; visthapit pani = utplavan. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Gravitation).

question: Newton ka dusra niyam kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Newton ka dusra niyam: F = ma (bal = dravyaman × twaran). | Galat kyun: Jadta pehla niyam hai; kriya-pratikriya teesra niyam hai; gurutvakarshan alag niyam hai. | Concept: Bal twaran paida karta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pehla jadta, dusra F=ma, teesra kriya-pratikriya. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Laws of Motion).

question: Shreni (series) me jude do pratirodh 4 ohm aur 6 ohm ka kul pratirodh kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Series me kul pratirodh judta hai: R = R1 + R2 = 4 + 6 = 10 ohm. | Galat kyun: 2.4 ohm parallel ka uttar hai (1/R = 1/4 + 1/6); 6 aur 24 ohm ganana ki galti hain. | Concept: Series me pratirodh badhta hai; parallel me kam hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Series = seedha jod; Parallel = ulta jod. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 11.

question: Ek vastu 20 m/s se chal rahi hai; 5 sec me kitni doori tay karegi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Doori = gati × samay = 20 × 5 = 100 m. | Galat kyun: 50 m (20 × 2.5) aur 25 m galat guna hain; 4 m (20 ÷ 5) bhag hai, guna nahi. | Concept: v = s/t, isliye s = v × t. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Doori = gati × samay — guna karo, bhag nahi. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Motion).

question: Samanya namak (common salt) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Samanya namak = NaCl (Sodium chloride). | Galat kyun: NaHCO3 baking soda hai; Na2CO3 washing soda hai; CaO quick lime (bina bujha chuna) hai. | Concept: Aam naam ↔ rasayanik sutra ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Namak NaCl; khane wala soda NaHCO3; dhone wala soda Na2CO3. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2 (Acids, Bases and Salts).

question: Baking soda ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Baking soda = NaHCO3 (Sodium bicarbonate). | Galat kyun: NaCl namak hai; CaSO4.1/2H2O Plaster of Paris hai; Ca(OH)2 bujha hua chuna (slaked lime) hai. | Concept: Aam naam ↔ rasayanik sutra ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Baking = Bicarbonate (donon 'B'). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: Shuddh pani ka pH kitna hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Shuddh pani ka pH 7 (neutral) hota hai; <7 acid, >7 base. | Galat kyun: 0 sabse acidic, 14 sabse basic hai; 5 halka acidic hai. | Concept: pH scale 0–14 par chalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 7 = neutral; 7 se neeche acid, upar base. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: Hawa me Nitrogen ki matra kitni hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Hawa me Nitrogen ~78% aur Oxygen ~21% hoti hai (baaki ~1% argon, CO2 aadi). | Galat kyun: 21% oxygen ki matra hai; 50% aur 1% galat hain. | Concept: Hawa mishran hai, ek gas nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 78-21-1 — Nitrogen, Oxygen, baaki. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Atmosphere).

question: Sirke (vinegar) me kaun sa acid hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Sirke (vinegar) me Acetic acid hota hai. | Galat kyun: Sulphuric acid gandhak ka tezab hai; Citric acid nimbu me hota hai; Hydrochloric acid pet me banta hai. | Concept: Khane ki cheez ↔ uska acid. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sirka = Acetic; Nimbu = Citric. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 2.

question: LPG me mukhya roop se kaun si gas hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — LPG me mukhya roop se Butane + Propane hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Hydrogen jalne wali gas hai, LPG me nahi; CO2 aag bujhane wali hai; Methane CNG me hota hai. | Concept: LPG = Liquefied Petroleum Gas. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: LPG = Butane+Propane; CNG = Methane. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 4 (Carbon and its Compounds).

question: Lohe par jang (rust) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Jang = Fe2O3.xH2O (hydrated ferric oxide); jang lagne ke liye hawa + nami dono chahiye. | Galat kyun: FeO ferrous oxide hai; FeS iron sulphide hai; Fe3O4 magnetite hai. | Concept: Lohe ka oxidation + pani = jang. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jang = Fe2O3.xH2O; rokne ke liye zinc ki parat (galvanisation). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 3 (Metals and Non-metals).

question: Parmanu sankhya (Atomic number) kya hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Parmanu sankhya (Z) = Proton ki sankhya; yahi element ki pehchan hai. | Galat kyun: Proton + Neutron = Mass number (A) hai; Neutron akela ya Electron + Neutron ka koi matlab nahi. | Concept: Z element tay karta hai; A uska bhar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Z = Proton; A = Proton+Neutron. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Structure of the Atom).

question: Koshika ka 'powerhouse' kise kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mitochondria ko 'powerhouse' kaha jata hai kyunki yahan shwasan se ATP (urja) banti hai. | Galat kyun: Nucleus niyantran karta hai (brain); Chloroplast photosynthesis karta hai (sirf paudhon me); Lysosome pachan karta hai (suicide bag). | Concept: Har koshikang ka apna kaam hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mitochondria = powerhouse; Nucleus = brain; Chloroplast = kitchen. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Fundamental Unit of Life).

question: Prakash sanshleshan (photosynthesis) me kaun si gas nikalti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Photosynthesis: 6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2; Oxygen bahar nikalti hai, CO2 andar jati hai. | Galat kyun: CO2 andar jati hai, bahar nahi; Nitrogen aur Hydrogen is prakriya me nahi nikalte. | Concept: Paudhe khana banate hain aur oxygen dete hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Paudhe CO2 lete hain, O2 dete hain. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 5 (Life Processes).

question: Universal donor blood group kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Blood group O universal donor hai: O par koi antigen nahi hota, isliye kisi ka plasma use attack nahi karta. | Galat kyun: AB universal recipient hai; A aur B sirf apne group (aur AB) ko de sakte hain. | Concept: Antigen na ho to koi attack nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sample chapter — 'O khali hai, isliye sabka hai'. | Source: samples/sample_07_science_blood_groups.md.

question: Universal recipient blood group kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — AB universal recipient hai: AB ke plasma me koi antibody nahi hota, isliye vah sabhi group se le sakta hai. | Galat kyun: O sirf O se le sakta hai; A aur B seemit group se le sakte hain. | Concept: Antibody na ho to koi rok nahi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sample chapter — 'AB bhara hai, isliye sab le sakta hai'. | Source: samples/sample_07_science_blood_groups.md.

question: Vayask manav me kul kitni haddiyan hoti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vayask manav me 206 haddiyan hoti hain; bacche me ~300 hoti hain (umar ke saath jud jati hain). | Galat kyun: 300 bacche ki sankhya hai; 216 aur 196 galat hain. | Concept: Haddiyan umar ke saath judti hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 206 — vayask; sabse badi Femur, sabse chhoti Stapes. | Source: NCERT Biology (Human Skeleton); standard reference.

question: Manav hriday me kitne kaksh hote hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Hriday me 4 kaksh hote hain (2 atria + 2 ventricles); samanya heartbeat ~72/min, BP 120/80 mmHg. | Galat kyun: 2, 3 ya 5 kaksh galat hain. | Concept: Dayein hissa ashuddh khoon, bayein hissa shuddh khoon sambhalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 4 kaksh — 2 upar (atria), 2 neeche (ventricles). | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 5.

question: Vitamin C ki kami se kaun sa rog hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vitamin C ki kami se Scurvy hota hai. | Galat kyun: Rickets Vitamin D se, Beriberi Vitamin B1 se, Night blindness Vitamin A se hota hai. | Concept: Vitamin ↔ kami-rog ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: C = Scurvy; D = Rickets; B1 = Beriberi; A = Night blindness. | Source: NCERT Class 10/11 (Nutrition).

question: Insulin kis granthi se banta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Insulin Pancreas (Agnashay) ki beta cells se banta hai; iski kami se Diabetes hota hai. | Galat kyun: Pituitary master gland hai; Adrenal adrenaline deti hai; Thyroid thyroxine deti hai. | Concept: Granthi ↔ hormone ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Insulin = Pancreas; Diabetes = Insulin ki kami. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 7 (Control and Coordination).

question: Malaria kis ke dwara failta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Malaria Plasmodium (protozoa) se hota hai aur Anopheles mada machhar se failta hai. | Galat kyun: Aedes dengue failata hai; housefly haija failata hai; bacteria se nahi, protozoa se hota hai. | Concept: Rog ↔ karak ↔ vahak ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Malaria = Anopheles; Dengue = Aedes. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science (Why Do We Fall Ill).

question: TB (Tuberculosis) kis se hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — TB Mycobacterium tuberculosis (bacteria) se hota hai; BCG tika lagta hai. | Galat kyun: Virus (flu), fungus (daadh), protozoa (malaria) — TB inme se kisi se nahi hota. | Concept: Rog ↔ karak ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: TB = Bacteria; BCG = TB ka tika. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science.

question: Chechak (smallpox) ka tika kisne khoja?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Edward Jenner ne 1796 me chechak (smallpox) ka tika khoja. | Galat kyun: Pasteur ne rabies ka tika diya; Salk ne polio ka; Fleming ne penicillin khoji. | Concept: Khoj ↔ vyakti ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jenner = chechak (1796); Pasteur = rabies. | Source: NCERT Class 9 Science.

question: Project Tiger kab shuru hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Project Tiger 1973 me shuru hua; pehla National Park Jim Corbett (1936) hai. | Galat kyun: 1982 Keoladeo ko UNESCO sthal milne ka varsh hai; 1970 aur 1975 galat hain. | Concept: Paryavaran karyakram ↔ varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Project Tiger 1973 — baagh bachao. | Source: Standard GK / NCERT Class 10 (Environment).

question: World Environment Day kab manaya jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — World Environment Day 5 June ko manaya jata hai. | Galat kyun: 22 April Earth Day hai; 16 Sep Ozone Day hai; 21 June Yoga Day hai. | Concept: Mahatvapurna din ↔ tareekh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 5 June = Paryavaran; 22 April = Prithvi. | Source: Standard GK.

question: Greenhouse gas kaun si nahi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Oxygen (O2) greenhouse gas nahi hai; CO2, CH4 aur N2O greenhouse gases hain. | Galat kyun: N2O, CH4 aur CO2 teeno garmi ko rokte hain. | Concept: Greenhouse gas = infrared vikiran ko rokne wali gas. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: CO2, CH4, N2O — greenhouse; O2 nahi. | Source: NCERT Class 9/10 (Environment).

question: Chipko Andolan kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Chipko Andolan (1973, Sunderlal Bahuguna, Uttarakhand) pedon ki raksha ke liye tha — log pedon se chipak gaye the. | Galat kyun: Jal sanrakshan, van jeev aur mitti sanrakshan is andolan ka seedha lakshya nahi the. | Concept: Andolan ↔ uska lakshya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Chipko = chipakna (ped se). | Source: NCERT Class 10 (Environment).

question: Master gland kise kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Pituitary ko master gland kaha jata hai kyunki vah dusri granthiyon ko niyantrit karti hai. | Galat kyun: Adrenal emergency hormone deti hai; Thyroid metabolism niyantrit karti hai; Pancreas insulin deta hai. | Concept: Granthi ↔ uska kaam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pituitary = master gland; Pancreas = insulin. | Source: NCERT Class 10 Science Ch. 7.
